constraints: THE SPECIFICATION IS FROZEN AND IMMUTABLE. Do not edit experiments/EXP-RT1476-001/specification.yaml; it is outside your write scope. If the protocol cannot be implemented as frozen, invoke STOP-4: stop, report the exact obstruction, and do not improvise a different measurement under this experiment id.

ANTI-TAUTOLOGY RULE, BINDING. No threshold (0.3, 0.6, 0.2, 1.5), expected value, verdict or answer key may be visible to the measuring code path; no pass/fail verdict may be emitted by the module. Threshold comparison happens in analysis.md and again independently in TASK-20260728-003. Every per-run gate quantity must be WRITTEN INTO raw-result.json - a number that appears only in stdout is a number that does not exist.

NINE RUNS MEANS NINE COMPUTATIONS. Each of the 27 run directories must be the product of a distinct computation on distinct inputs. If any two raw-result.json files are byte-identical when their inputs differ, INVALID-6 fires and the run set is returned. EXP-GGM-001 computed once and serialized nine times; do not repeat it.

EVERY CLAIMED RELATION CARRIES A CERTIFICATE AND THE WRAPPER RE-VERIFIES IT INDEPENDENTLY. A root of the backward eliminant lying in the forward state is a CANDIDATE, never a relation, because S3 is x-only and does not determine signs. A relation exists only when an explicit signed 5-tuple satisfies the group identity on E. One failing certificate invalidates its whole cell (INVALID-3).

THE SUCCESS-SUBSET RESTRICTION IS THE POINT OF THE EXPERIMENT. beta_ops is fitted on ops_success only - operations spent on queries that produced a verified certificate. Report ops_all separately so the excluded abort speedup is auditable. Never pool them, never fit on the aggregate, never substitute wall-clock for either.

ops_success MUST BE A REAL INSTRUMENTED INTEGER from a hand-written GF(p) arithmetic layer used by the query path, with multiplications, additions/subtractions and inversions counted separately under a declared weighting. If any part of the query path is a black-box sympy routine, those operations are UNCOUNTABLE: record ops_success as null with that reason (INVALID-7) rather than substituting a proxy or an estimate.

CURVE CONSTRUCTION: do NOT use harness.toycurve.generate_instance. It chooses p itself and cannot be told to use 16769023, and it calls the naive O(p) EllipticCurve.order() at field_bits <= 24, which at p = 16769023 is 16.7 million modular exponentiations per candidate curve. Construct EllipticCurve(p, a, b) directly and use order_bsgs(). Verify each p is prime at run time; if any fails, STOP rather than substituting a modulus.

REJECTION-SAMPLE THE FULL CURVE PREDICATE: #E prime, ordinary, non-anomalous (n != p), j(E) not in {0, 1728}, non-singular. Record the rejection count per cell; a rejection is a sampler property, not evidence.

TARGETS ARE UNIFORMLY RANDOM: R = [r]P with r uniform in [1, q-1] from the deterministic seed stream, 1200 per cell. PLANTED TARGETS ARE FORBIDDEN IN THE FIT - summing five random factor-base points samples targets weighted by their number of decompositions, a different distribution. Any planted diagnostic goes in a separate labelled block and is never pooled.

RUN BOTH CONTROLS AT ALL THREE SIZES AND ALL THREE SEEDS under identical instrumentation, the same PRS variant, the same counter, the same target count and the same session. CTRL-POS differs in exactly one declared respect (planted factor base) and CTRL-NEG in exactly one (randomized dense chain links). Nothing else may differ.

RESPECT THE STOPPING RULES AND REPORT WHAT THEY STOPPED: 900 s per eliminant, 1800 s per cell, 7200 s total. A timeout, crash or memory exhaustion is INFRASTRUCTURE SIGNAL under AGENTS.md rule 5, is NEVER a negative mathematical result, and is never evidence against H-RT1476-001. Do not extrapolate, interpolate or estimate an uncompleted cell.

YOU RECORD OBSERVATIONS ONLY. Change no record status, write no ledger record, write no evidence record. analysis.md may state what the numbers are and how they compare to the frozen thresholds; it may not state what they mean for ECDLP, for the gate's status, or for any attack.

REPORT UNEXPECTED OBSERVATIONS RATHER THAN DISCARDING THEM (AGENTS.md rule 8): a systematic gap between deg_u and the enumerated support size, a success rate far from L^5/(120 q), or seed-to-seed instability are findings to record, not noise to smooth.
NEVER FABRICATE a command, output, timing, statistic, citation or run. A quantity that cannot be computed is recorded null with its reason.

SCOPE EVERY SENTENCE. Maximum claim tier is toy (24-bit maximum field). Nothing you produce is evidence for or against ECDLP hardness, prime-field ECDLP, index calculus at any relevant scale, or KN-OPEN-001. No live keys, deployed systems or private targets.
